bio: Befitting the elegance that characterises the Victoria Jungfrau Grand Hotel & Spa, which is steeped in tradition, a classically refined atmosphere awaits you here. The location against the impressive backdrop of the mountains is a real draw in itself. In summer, make a beeline for the terrace on the promenade! The menu includes a broad assortment of Arab, Asian, Mediterranean and Swiss dishes – flavoursome food made from high-quality ingredients....
